comment: Landed-tool parity pin registry. The landed_digest_guard.py hourly tripwire compares the blob digest of each pinned path on origin/main against 'digest'. digest: sha256 hex of the file content, or null when the tool has not landed yet (then queued_prs carries the expected digest(s)). queued_prs: open PRs that introduce or modify the path; head digest verified live on every tick so a force-push after capture flips QUEUED to DRIFT. Re-pinning after an intended change requires a PR with its own tester attestation; the guard itself never mutates anything.
